summary: Backend API regression tests passed. Desktop dashboard, Kanban CRUD, search/filter, staff directory, analytics, export confirmation, and mobile overflow checks passed; mobile navigation is inaccessible.

ui_bugs.issue: The mobile menu button is visible but has no click handler; the hidden sidebar remains inaccessible on mobile.

issues: Today label is hardcoded to Senin, 13 Januari 2025 instead of deriving the current date.
Tambah staf only displays an informational toast; the requested admin staff-entry flow is not implemented.

action_items: Add mobile menu state and render/open a usable navigation drawer or sidebar.
Derive the displayed daily date from the current date or a configured reporting date.
Implement the admin add-staff flow if staff management is in scope.
critical_code_review_comments: mobile-menu-button has no onClick and sidebar is display:none below 700px, blocking mobile navigation.
POST /api/export is a readiness confirmation only; it does not perform live Google Sheets upload (MOCKED integration).
seed_data_creation: Backend seed data was existing 85 staff and 4 demo tasks. One temporary UI task was created for CRUD testing and deleted afterward.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public deployment tested without authentication. API CRUD/analytics/export and desktop UI flows pass. Retest mobile menu after adding navigation behavior; export remains MOCKED and was only checked for readiness toast.
rca of the issue: At mobile breakpoint App.css hides .sidebar, while App.js renders mobile-menu-button without an onClick or drawer state. Clicking the button therefore cannot reveal navigation.
